items.q: Does the system have the ability to integrate with existing accounting or ERP software?
items.a: Winterfrost designs the system based on API-First architecture, allowing direct connection to popular platforms such as SAP, Oracle, Misa or other specialized management software. We perform data synchronization through RESTful API protocols or Webhooks to ensure the consistent flow of financial and commodity information across departments.

items.q: How does the system handle overload during major promotions?
items.a: We apply Auto-scaling solutions on Cloud infrastructure combined with Caching and Load Balancing techniques. This architecture allows the system to dynamically scale server resources in real-time to handle thousands of simultaneous access requests and transactions without causing crashes or delays.

items.q: What mechanism ensures that inventory discrepancies do not occur when selling multi-channel?
items.a: The system uses transaction control mechanism and Pessimistic/Optimistic Locking record locking technique. When an order is created on any channel such as website, app, POS, the system will immediately hold the corresponding inventory quantity in a centralized database before confirming the order, completely eliminating the risk of overselling the actual quantity.

items.q: To what standards is customer data and transaction information secured?
items.a: All sensitive data is encrypted at the storage level using the AES-256 algorithm and encrypted in transit via TLS/SSL protocol. In addition, we set up an access authorization system based on RBAC roles and activity tracking to control and retrieve all operations affecting the system's data.

items.q: Can POS software work when there is an Internet connection failure?
items.a: We program the offline mode feature using local storage. Employees can still perform sales operations and print invoices normally when there is a network outage. As soon as the Internet connection is restored, the system will automatically perform the process of synchronizing data to the central server to update sales and inventory.

items.q: What are the maintenance costs and the ability to upgrade the system after handover?
items.a: The system is built on a Modular structure in the form of independent modules, helping to upgrade or add new features quickly without restructuring the entire source code. Regarding maintenance costs, Winterfrost optimizes source code to minimize hardware resource consumption, helping businesses save on monthly infrastructure operating costs, while providing full technical documentation for internal teams to manage.

faq.label: Frequently asked questions
faq.title: Answering All Questions
faq.intro: Frequently asked questions about Logistics system engineering

items.q: Is the system compatible with different types of GPS devices?
items.a: Yes, Winterfrost designs flexible data reception ports via API protocol to connect directly to most types of journey monitoring hardware currently on the market. We ensure data from peripheral devices is standardized and flows to the central system synchronously.

items.q: How to ensure data is not lost when the vehicle moves into a signal loss area?
items.a: We apply a data storage mechanism in the local memory of the terminal application. As soon as the device restores network connection, the system will perform an automatic synchronization process to ensure the itinerary and cargo status are fully updated to the server.

items.q: Is the system capable of processing thousands of bills of lading at the same time during peak hours?
items.a: Yes, Microservices architecture combined with a message queuing mechanism helps the system process large transaction volumes in parallel. This prevents data congestion and ensures system response speed is always stable under 2 seconds.

items.q: How secure is information about operating costs and customer routes?
items.a: All sensitive data is encrypted according to the AES 256 standard. We set up a role-based access authorization system to ensure that only authorized personnel can access financial information and customer data.

items.q: What is the average time to complete and put the system into operation?
items.a: The implementation process from the survey stage to actual handover usually lasts from 12 to 16 weeks. This time includes custom programming, load testing and technical training for the business's staff.

items.q: Does the system support automatic calculation of tolls and fuel surcharges?
items.a: Yes, we program automatic calculation engines based on the actual travel route and standard fee schedule of the business. This feature helps eliminate discrepancies in expense reports and helps the accounting department control cash flow more accurately.
